text: What did we invoice this year by business, against the plan, and at what margin?
rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + fin.revenue_plan + ops.facility at high confidence (0.94).
sql:
SELECT i.business_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS period, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, ANY_VALUE(r.plan_usd) AS plan
FROM fin.invoice_line i
JOIN fin.revenue_plan r ON r.business_code = i.business_code AND r.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2

text: Which units are booked above 90% of capacity for the fourth quarter?
rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.process_unit at high confidence (0.93).
sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.booked_tons) AS booked, SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS capacity, SUM(b.booked_tons) / SUM(b.capacity_tons) AS share
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week BETWEEN 40 AND 52
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY share DESC

text: Which approved profiles are under the 15% stream floor at today's fees?
rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + fin.treatment_cost + fin.transport_lane + fin.state_fee at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.price_usd_ton, fc.full_cost_usd_ton, (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN full_cost fc ON fc.facility_code = p.facility_code AND fc.process_code = p.process_code AND fc.origin_region = (SELECT origin_region FROM ops.generator g WHERE g.generator_id = p.generator_id)
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND (p.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / p.price_usd_ton < 0.15

text: What do third-party outlets cost us this year, and which approvals expire next?
rationale: Resolves across ops.third_party_manifest + ops.third_party_approval at high confidence (0.91).
sql:
SELECT t.outlet_id, SUM(t.tons) AS tons, SUM(t.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM ops.third_party_manifest t
GROUP BY 1

text: Which generators send the most off-spec loads?
rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.receipt_discrepancy + ops.generator at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT m.generator_id, COUNTIF(m.off_spec) / COUNT(*) AS off_spec_rate, COUNT(*) AS receipts
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING receipts >= 20
ORDER BY off_spec_rate DESC

text: How many shipments exceeded the ten-day transfer limit this year, and at which service centers?
rationale: Resolves across ops.transfer_hold + ops.facility at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT h.center_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', h.arrived_on) AS month, COUNTIF(h.exceeded_ten_days) AS exceeded, COUNT(*) AS holds
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
GROUP BY 1, 2

text: Which profiles are pending approval, and which of them are waiting on a laboratory result?
rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + ops.profile_analytical at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, DATE_DIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), p.received_on, DAY) AS days_pending, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.profile_analytical a WHERE a.profile_id = p.profile_id AND a.released_on IS NOT NULL) AS result_released
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Pending'

text: What is booked against the capacity of each incineration unit, and what headroom is left in November?
rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.process_unit at high confidence (0.93).
sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.capacity_tons - b.booked_tons) AS headroom_tons
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week IN (45, 46) AND NOT b.outage
GROUP BY 1, 2

text: What is the margin by facility and unit this year?
rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + ops.facility at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT i.facility_code, i.process_code, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY margin_pct

text: Which units could take each of the six Halden streams under their permits?
rationale: Resolves across ops.facility_permit_code + ops.process_unit + the Halden profiles at high confidence (0.9); customer requirements read from QR-14 in Drive.
sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

text: What does the Port Terrell outage strand, and where can each shipment go?
rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.capacity_booking + ops.facility_permit_code + ops.transfer_hold at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.generator_id, m.facility_code, m.process_code, m.tons, m.eta
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND (b.outage OR b.booked_tons > b.capacity_tons)

text: How long does a profile take from receipt to approval?
rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile at medium confidence (0.8): receipt dates are carried for profiles received since 2025.
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(p.approved_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(p.approved_on, p.received_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.approved_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

text: Which third-party approvals expire in the next 60 days, and which streams depend on them?
rationale: Resolves across ops.third_party_approval + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.93).
sql:
SELECT a.outlet_id, a.profile_id, a.generator_id, a.expires_on, a.cost_usd_ton
FROM ops.third_party_approval a
WHERE a.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 60 DAY)

text: What does a re-route from Port Terrell to Granger cost a ton on the rate card, by origin region?
rationale: Resolves across fin.transport_lane + fin.treatment_cost + fin.state_fee at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, (fc_alt.full_cost_usd_ton - fc_now.full_cost_usd_ton) * m.tons AS extra_cost_usd
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN full_cost fc_now ON fc_now.facility_code = m.facility_code AND fc_now.process_code = m.process_code
JOIN full_cost fc_alt ON fc_alt.facility_code = :alt_facility AND fc_alt.process_code = m.process_code

text: Which shipments are on the pad at Galena Shores today, and when does each one's clock run out?
rationale: Resolves across ops.transfer_hold + ops.manifest at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT h.manifest_id, h.center_code, h.arrived_on, h.days_held, h.deadline
FROM ops.transfer_hold h
WHERE h.left_on IS NULL
ORDER BY h.deadline

text: How many Harbor Line and Tidewater profiles are still on the legacy system, and how many has a chemist reviewed?
rationale: Resolves across legacy.legacy_profile + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT l.source_company, COUNT(*) AS profiles, COUNTIF(l.reviewed) AS reviewed
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
GROUP BY 1

text: Which approved profiles expire in the next 90 days, and what revenue rides on them?
rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + ops.generator at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.generator_id, p.expires_on, p.annual_tons * p.price_usd_ton AS annual_revenue
FROM ops.waste_profile p
WHERE p.status = 'Approved' AND p.expires_on BETWEEN CURRENT_DATE() AND DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

text: What would the six Halden streams earn a year by route, at the price book, on full cost?
rationale: Resolves across the Halden profiles + fin.price_book + fin.treatment_cost + fin.transport_lane + fin.state_fee at high confidence (0.88); capacity notes from ops.capacity_booking.
sql:
SELECT q.profile_id, q.facility_code, q.process_code, q.price_usd_ton, (q.price_usd_ton - fc.full_cost_usd_ton) / q.price_usd_ton AS margin_pct
FROM fin.quote_line q
JOIN full_cost fc USING (facility_code, process_code)

text: Can Port Terrell carry the Halden process wastewater in the first quarter, on what is booked today?
rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.process_unit at medium confidence (0.82): the first-quarter plan is not published; the fourth quarter is repeated.
sql:
SELECT b.facility_code, b.process_code, SUM(b.capacity_tons - b.booked_tons) AS headroom_tons
FROM ops.capacity_booking b
WHERE b.iso_week IN (45, 46) AND NOT b.outage
GROUP BY 1, 2

text: Which of the six Halden streams meet the destruction requirement at which units, and which outlets are ruled out by it?
rationale: Resolves across ops.facility_permit_code + the Halden profiles + QR-14 and the Bayou Verde permit summary in Drive at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

text: Which Halden streams carry a laboratory finding the profile did not say?
rationale: Resolves across ops.profile_analytical + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', a.sampled_on) AS month, APPROX_QUANTILES(DATE_DIFF(a.released_on, a.sampled_on, DAY), 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS median_days
FROM ops.profile_analytical a
GROUP BY 1

text: Which quotes this year were priced below the price book, and by how much?
rationale: Resolves across fin.quote_line + fin.price_book at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT ql.quote_id, ql.profile_id, ql.price_usd_ton, ql.book_price_usd_ton, 1 - ql.price_usd_ton / ql.book_price_usd_ton AS discount
FROM fin.quote_line ql
WHERE ql.price_usd_ton < ql.book_price_usd_ton

text: How many profiles were approved before their laboratory result was released?
rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + ops.profile_analytical at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT p.profile_id, p.approved_on, MIN(a.released_on) AS first_release
FROM ops.waste_profile p
JOIN ops.profile_analytical a USING (profile_id)
GROUP BY 1, 2
HAVING p.approved_on < first_release

text: What is our quote turnaround, and how many quotes went out after the date the customer asked for?
rationale: Resolves across fin.quote at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC(q.issued_on, QUARTER) AS quarter, AVG(q.turnaround_days) AS avg_days, COUNTIF(q.issued_on > q.due_on) AS late
FROM fin.quote q
WHERE q.issued_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1

text: Which permits and outlet approvals come up for decision in the next 90 days?
rationale: Resolves across ops.process_unit + ops.third_party_outlet + the compliance notes in Drive at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT 'facility' AS kind, f.facility_code AS id, f.unit_note AS note FROM ops.process_unit f WHERE f.unit_note LIKE '%renewal%'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'outlet', t.outlet_id, CAST(t.approval_expires_on AS STRING) FROM ops.third_party_outlet t WHERE t.approval_expires_on <= DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 90 DAY)

text: What does the 1 November fee rise do to margin, and which contracts carry the pass-through clause?
rationale: Resolves across fin.state_fee + ops.manifest + ops.facility at medium confidence (0.84): the pass-through clause is read from the contract files, not a column.
sql:
SELECT fa.state, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(f_new.fee_usd_ton - f_old.fee_usd_ton) AS fee_change
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.facility fa USING (facility_code)
JOIN fin.state_fee f_old ON f_old.state = fa.state AND f_old.valid_to IS NOT NULL
JOIN fin.state_fee f_new ON f_new.state = fa.state AND f_new.valid_to IS NULL
GROUP BY 1

text: How much has gone to third-party outlets this year, by outlet, and what did it cost above our own units?
rationale: Resolves across ops.third_party_manifest + ops.third_party_outlet at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT t.outlet_id, SUM(t.tons) AS tons, SUM(t.cost_usd) AS cost
FROM ops.third_party_manifest t
GROUP BY 1

text: Which generators pay different prices for the same process?
rationale: Resolves across ops.waste_profile + fin.price_book at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC

text: Which lanes carry the most tons, and what do they cost a ton?
rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.generator + fin.transport_lane at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT g.origin_region, m.facility_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, ANY_VALUE(l.rate_usd_ton) AS rate, ANY_VALUE(l.loaded_miles) AS miles
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.generator g USING (generator_id)
JOIN fin.transport_lane l ON l.origin_region = g.origin_region AND l.facility_code = m.facility_code
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

text: Where is the Halford Retail Services tanker right now?
rationale: Declined: carrier tracking is not connected; the manifest's expected arrival is answered instead.

text: What has Cypress Landing taken since it opened, against its permitted capacity?
rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.process_unit at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
WHERE m.facility_code = 'CYP' AND m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1

text: Which generators are our largest by revenue this year, and at what margin?
rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + ops.generator at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT i.generator_id, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, 1 - SUM(i.full_cost_usd) / SUM(i.amount_usd) AS margin_pct
FROM fin.invoice_line i
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY revenue DESC

text: Which waste codes do we receive the most of, and at which units?
rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.waste_profile at high confidence (0.9).
sql:
SELECT c AS waste_code, m.process_code, SUM(m.tons) AS tons
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.waste_profile p USING (profile_id), UNNEST(SPLIT(p.waste_codes, ',')) c
WHERE m.status = 'Received'
GROUP BY 1, 2

text: What does the legacy price book charge against our 2026 price book for the same processes?
rationale: Resolves across legacy.legacy_profile + fin.price_book at high confidence (0.88).
sql:
SELECT l.ironbridge_profile_id, l.legacy_price_usd_ton, b.price_usd_ton AS book, l.legacy_price_usd_ton / b.price_usd_ton - 1 AS gap
FROM legacy.legacy_profile l
JOIN ops.waste_profile p ON p.profile_id = l.ironbridge_profile_id
JOIN fin.price_book b ON b.process_code = p.process_code

text: What will competitors quote Halden for the process wastewater?
rationale: Declined: competitor and market pricing are not in any connected source.

text: What is each business's revenue by facility this year?
rationale: Resolves across fin.invoice_line + ops.facility at high confidence (0.93).
sql:
SELECT i.business_code, FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS period, SUM(i.amount_usd) AS revenue, ANY_VALUE(r.plan_usd) AS plan
FROM fin.invoice_line i
JOIN fin.revenue_plan r ON r.business_code = i.business_code AND r.period = FORMAT_DATE('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date)
GROUP BY 1, 2

text: If the Port Terrell outage runs a week longer, which further shipments lose their outlet?
rationale: Resolves across ops.manifest + ops.capacity_booking at medium confidence (0.8): it extends the outage weeks and reads the bookings.
sql:
SELECT m.manifest_id, m.generator_id, m.facility_code, m.process_code, m.tons, m.eta
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND (b.outage OR b.booked_tons > b.capacity_tons)

text: Is the Halden solvent waste acceptable at Fox Hollow for fuel blending?
rationale: Resolves across ops.process_unit + ops.profile_analytical + the fuel blending limits note in Drive at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT u.facility_code, u.process_code
FROM ops.process_unit u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(:codes, ',')) c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ops.facility_permit_code pc WHERE pc.facility_code = u.facility_code AND pc.process_code = u.process_code AND pc.waste_code = c))

text: What will the Texas disposal fee be in 2027?
rationale: Declined: the graph holds the fee schedule in force, not legislation to come.

text: Will Halden sign if we quote Granger instead of Port Terrell?
rationale: Declined: the graph does not predict a customer's decision; what Halden asked for is answered instead.

text: Has the Riverbend laboratory released the Halden results?
rationale: Resolves across ops.profile_analytical at high confidence (0.95).
sql:
SELECT a.profile_id, a.parameter, a.value, a.unit, a.released_on
FROM ops.profile_analytical a
JOIN ops.waste_profile p USING (profile_id)
WHERE p.generator_id = 'G11100'

text: Is the Halden process wastewater RCRA hazardous under Texas rules without a TCLP result?
rationale: Declined: a classification needs the released result; the profile's stated codes and the released results are answered instead.

text: What does Priya need for the Halden proposal by Friday, and what is ready?
rationale: Resolves across the mailbox (thread A1) and the proposal folder at medium confidence (0.84).

text: Which units are down or over capacity this week, and what is booked to them?
rationale: Resolves across ops.capacity_booking + ops.manifest at high confidence (0.92).
sql:
SELECT m.facility_code, COUNT(*) AS manifests, SUM(m.tons) AS tons, SUM(m.revenue_usd) AS revenue
FROM ops.manifest m
JOIN ops.capacity_booking b ON b.facility_code = m.facility_code AND b.process_code = m.process_code AND b.iso_week = m.booked_week
WHERE m.status IN ('Booked', 'In transit') AND b.outage
GROUP BY 1

text: Which incinerator will fail next?
rationale: Declined: equipment condition and failure history are not connected, and the graph does not predict failures.
